tools.name: create_openings_from_clash
tools.description: Place opening voids where linked or local MEP solid-intersects a selected wall/floor/beam. Call immediately; do not ask to bind links. Pass hostIds or select a host — a section box is not a host.

tools.name: cut_hosts_by_openings
tools.description: Cut local hosts with opening voids. Uses current selection. Linked hosts are skipped, not cut.
